note: Inputs that stage S3 tries to source by web search. Bands are sanity limits (assumed): a value outside its band stays assumed. Descriptions are what the support judge checks the quote against, so they state the definition the model uses.

fx_idr_per_usd.label: assumed
fx_idr_per_usd.note: IDR per USD, rounded market level; only used when a source states rupiah

targets.description: installed capital cost of a solar PV plant per kWp (or per kW) in Indonesia or Southeast Asia
targets.search_brief: installed capital cost of a ground-mounted or mini-grid solar PV plant per kWp (or per kW DC) in Indonesia, or in Southeast Asia if no Indonesian figure exists

targets.description: annual fixed operation and maintenance cost of a solar PV plant per kWp (or per kW)
targets.search_brief: annual fixed operation and maintenance cost of a utility-scale or mini-grid solar PV plant per kW per year, in Indonesia or Southeast Asia if available

targets.description: installed capital cost of a lithium-ion battery energy storage system per kWh of storage energy
targets.search_brief: installed capital cost of a lithium-ion battery energy storage system per kWh of storage energy, for utility or mini-grid scale, in Indonesia or Southeast Asia if available

targets.description: annual fixed operation and maintenance cost of a lithium-ion battery storage system per kWh of storage energy
targets.search_brief: annual fixed operation and maintenance cost of a lithium-ion battery energy storage system per kWh per year

targets.description: price per litre of industrial (non-subsidised) diesel fuel in Indonesia
targets.search_brief: price of industrial (non-subsidised) diesel fuel (solar / biosolar B35 or B40, industri) in Indonesia per litre

targets.description: real (inflation-adjusted) discount rate for solar PV or renewable energy projects in Indonesia
targets.search_brief: real (inflation-adjusted) discount rate used to evaluate solar PV or renewable energy projects in Indonesia

targets.description: minimum load of a diesel generator set as a share of its rated power
targets.search_brief: recommended minimum load of a diesel generator set in a mini-grid or island power system, as a share of its rated power
